name: detective-board-sync
description: Real-time asynchronous co-op detective mystery game played on a shared digital corkboard

scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc --noEmit
